items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: Sweets was in it and Conte Candoli and John Audino was the trumpet section

ctx.x: Yeah. Pearly Mae. She was fantastic. And she had a show at the Hollywood Palace and the band was Louie’s big band and I was in it and Sweets was in it and Conte Candoli and John Audino was the trumpet section. And Pops is on the show one day. Actually it was two dates, one day of rehearsal and one day for recording. And Sweets knew Pops

very well. And he came over and was with us all day. And I got to hang out with Pops, with Satchmo, with Louis Armstrong all day. And it was two days I got to hang with him. And one of the — I mean that kind of experience and that was so beautiful just to listen to him talk and to talk to him, and him and Sweets, the two of them going back and forth telling stories about this and about that. And you know so just me being around all these people I got to meet all the legends and all my idols. All my idols I got to…
